I created this subverse with the intention to discuss community resilience. The reason for this is because I notice that (at least where I'm from, the UK) communities are very poorly equipped to deal with possible adverse situations. What is welcome:

  • Stories, please tell us your story about your local community. Inspire us or ask for help!
  • Articles, sure post interesting and related articles. These can come from news sources or they can be people's personal blogs.

5 minutes of handstand practice means you set a timer for 5 minutes and do handstands, resting as long as you need in between sessions. Rest is included in time. Each time you will be able to hold it longer and longer.
